claim_judgments.rationale: C0000 faithfully captures paragraph (a)'s baseline structure specifying that, except as provided in paragraphs (b) and (f), a flight review consists of a minimum of 1 hour of flight training and 1 hour of ground training.

C0001 covers the mandatory content of the flight review under § 61.56(a)(1) and (a)(2), requiring both the review of current general operating and flight rules of part 91 and the maneuvers/procedures at the instructor's discretion.

C0002 accurately extracts § 61.56(b), allowing glider pilots to substitute a minimum of three instructional flights in a glider (each including a flight to traffic pattern altitude) in lieu of the 1 hour of flight training.

C0003 accurately captures the prohibition and dual prerequisites under § 61.56(c) for acting as pilot in command, including the 24-calendar-month lookback period, flight review accomplishment, and endorsed logbook.

C0004 faithfully reflects § 61.56(d)(1), exempting a person from the flight review if they passed a proficiency check or practical test for a certificate, rating, or operating privilege within the 24-calendar-month period specified in paragraph (c).

C0005 accurately groups and reflects § 61.56(d)(2)(i)-(iv), exempting a person who passed an examiner practical test for flight instructor issuance, additional rating, recent experience (§ 61.197(b)(1)), or reinstatement (§ 61.199(b)(2)) within the lookback period.

C0006 faithfully captures § 61.56(e), providing an exemption from the flight review for satisfactorily accomplishing one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program within the paragraph (c) period.

C0007 correctly captures § 61.56(f), allowing a flight instructor certificate holder who completed recent experience under § 61.197 or reinstated privileges under § 61.199(a)(1) within the paragraph (c) timeframe to omit the 1 hour of ground training.
C0008 faithfully states the exemption in § 61.56(g) for student pilots undergoing training for a certificate who hold a current solo flight endorsement under § 61.87.

C0009 accurately reproduces the permission in § 61.56(h) allowing flight review requirements to be accomplished in combination with § 61.57 and other recent experience requirements at instructor discretion.

C0010 covers the permission to use a flight simulator or flight training device and the condition under § 61.56(i)(1) requiring use in accordance with an approved course by a part 142 training center.

C0011 captures § 61.56(i)(2), retaining the governing scope of simulator/FTD use, the exception for landing-approved simulators, and the requirement to meet takeoff and landing requirements under § 61.57(a) or (b).
C0012 accurately extracts § 61.56(i)(3), requiring the flight simulator or flight training device used to represent an aircraft or set of aircraft for which the pilot is rated.

C0001 covers U0001 by including the requirement to review the current general operating and flight rules of part 91.
C0001 covers U0002 by including the requirement to review maneuvers and procedures necessary at the instructor's discretion to demonstrate safe exercise of certificate privileges.
C0002 fully covers U0003 regarding the substitution of three instructional flights in a glider for glider pilots.

C0003 covers U0004 as part of its combined extraction of paragraph (c)(1), requiring completion of a flight review in an aircraft for which the pilot is rated by an authorized instructor within 24 calendar months.
C0003 covers U0005 as part of its combined extraction of paragraph (c)(2), requiring an endorsed logbook from the instructor certifying satisfactory completion.
C0004 fully covers U0006 regarding exemption via pilot proficiency check or practical test for a certificate, rating, or operating privilege.
C0005 covers U0007 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(d)(2) practical tests, specifically the issuance of a flight instructor certificate.
C0005 covers U0008 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(d)(2) practical tests, specifically an additional rating on a flight instructor certificate.
C0005 covers U0009 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(d)(2) practical tests, specifically meeting recent experience requirements under § 61.197(b)(1).
C0005 covers U0010 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(d)(2) practical tests, specifically reinstatement under § 61.199(b)(2).
C0006 covers U0011 regarding exemption via completion of one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program.
C0007 covers U0012 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(f), specifically ground training exemption via completing recent experience requirements under § 61.197.
C0007 covers U0013 as part of its grouped representation of § 61.56(f), specifically ground training exemption via completing an approved flight instructor refresher course under § 61.199(a)(1).
C0008 fully covers U0014 regarding the student pilot exemption under § 61.56(g).
C0009 fully covers U0015 regarding combining flight review with § 61.57 and other recent experience requirements under § 61.56(h).
C0010 covers U0016 regarding simulator/FTD use in accordance with an approved course by a part 142 training center.
C0011 covers U0017 regarding meeting § 61.57(a) or (b) takeoff and landing requirements unless the simulator is approved for landings.
C0012 covers U0018 regarding the requirement that the simulator or FTD represent an aircraft or set of aircraft for which the pilot is rated.
